notes.title: Turtoa: Global Rhythm chat around the world
notes.notes:
Turtoa: Global Rhythm is a love affair with exotic musical sounds from around the world. Whilst high on the sonic jam a magical turtle appeared and showed us the way. 

Chat with the Turtoa developers! Ask us anything, really anything. We can share more details on how the beatmap system and modding will work.  We will do our best to make you laugh with our highly suspect jokes ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Turtoa: Global Rhythm - LIVESTREAM
notes.notes:
Watch the Maestro play through Turtoa: Global Rhythm live and uncut. We will start with the demo levels and work into unreleased and in-development levels. There will also be a demonstration of the Beatmap Creator interface for interested modders.

Ask the devs questions and chat with other fans.

😁🎶🌠
